title: Skill Contract Schema
description: Declares a skill's input assumptions, output files, DAG, and field semantics in machine-readable form. All sections are optional in default mode; semantics is optional in universal mode.

input.description: Assumptions about the skill's input data: encoding, column schema, and file path patterns.

encoding.description: Expected character encoding for input files (e.g. utf-8, latin-1).

columns.description: Map of column name to expected data type. Types use plain strings: string, integer, float, boolean, date, datetime.

file_patterns.description: Glob patterns for input files the skill expects (e.g. ['*.csv', 'data/*.xlsx']).

output.description: Files produced by the skill and their field schemas. Keys are output artifact names.

path.description: Relative path from the skill root to the output file.

fields.description: Map of field name to expected data type.

dag.description: Directed acyclic graph of pipeline steps: execution order and dependencies.

steps.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps. Implicit execution order is array index; depends_on declares explicit data dependencies.

name.description: Unique step identifier matching a function or script name.

depends_on.description: Names of steps that must complete before this one.

description.description: What this step does, in natural language.

semantics.description: Business rules, allowed values, and field-level meaning. Mirrors the column-level decisions made in Phase 2.

meaning.description: What this field represents in business terms.

allowed.description: Exhaustive list of permitted values (for categorical/enum fields). Nullable values should include null explicitly.

rules.description: Business rules or constraints expressed as natural-language strings.
